Class ViewLessonDetails

java.lang.Object
guiLessonDetails.ViewLessonDetails
public class ViewLessonDetails extends Object

Title: ViewLessonDetails Class.

Description: The JavaFX-based Lesson Details View. This class displays the selected Lesson Details and every associated Experience and provides Update, Delete, and Close actions.

Version:
1.0 2026-10-23 Initial version after MVC refactoring
Author:
Venus Ho, Alexander Murray, Alan Shimp, Caleb Beaven, Krithik Duraisamy

      public ViewLessonDetails()

      Description: Creates the Lesson Details View. The display operation is static, so the application does not need to instantiate this class.

  • Method Details

    • displayLessonDetails

      protected static void displayLessonDetails(javafx.stage.Stage owner, entityClasses.LessonsLearned lesson, entityClasses.ExperiencesList experiences, Runnable onUpdate, Runnable onDeleted)

      Method: displayLessonDetails()

      Description: Displays the selected lesson and its Experience history in a scrollable popup using the Contributor sage theme.

      Parameters:
      owner - window that owns the Lesson Details popup
      lesson - lesson whose information is displayed
      experiences - Experiences associated with the lesson
      onUpdate - operation used to open the Update Lesson form
      onDeleted - operation used to refresh the calling page after deletion

    • createExperienceHistory

      private static javafx.scene.layout.VBox createExperienceHistory(entityClasses.ExperiencesList experiences)

      Method: createExperienceHistory()

      Description: Creates the Experiences section and displays each associated Experience in its own card.

      Parameters:
      experiences - collection of Experiences associated with the lesson
      Returns:
      vertically arranged Experience heading and cards

    • createDetailLabel

      private static javafx.scene.layout.VBox createDetailLabel(String name, String value)

      Method: createDetailLabel()

      Description: Creates one labeled and wrapped information block for the Lesson Details popup.

      Parameters:

    • showDeleteConfirmation

      private static void showDeleteConfirmation(javafx.stage.Stage detailStage, entityClasses.LessonsLearned lesson, Runnable onDeleted)

      Method: showDeleteConfirmation()

      Description: Asks the contributor to confirm permanent lesson deletion before sending the action to the Controller.

      Parameters:
      detailStage - Lesson Details window associated with the deletion
      lesson - lesson selected for deletion
      onDeleted - operation used to refresh the calling page

      protected static void showMessage(javafx.stage.Stage owner, String title, String message, boolean error)

      Method: showMessage()

      Description: Displays a styled success or error message associated with the Lesson Details popup.
